evals.prompt: 用 paper-collage-video 帮我把这句做成拼贴 B-roll：很多人以为 AI 是来替你思考的，其实它更像一面镜子，会把你问题里的漏洞照出来。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 1, should only propose one clear visual metaphor with key objects, assembly order, and a batch background color confirmation. If the user did not specify a background color, it should default to unified dark green #1E4F3D, then stop for approval. It must not generate an image or call any video model yet.

evals.prompt: 上一轮你给的‘知识卡片通过轨道重新连成网络’隐喻我确认了。继续帮我做静帧，底色不要全是蓝色，素材可以有彩色纸片。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 2, should create an editorial halftone paper-collage visual spec and final still using the confirmed unified background color, vary only local accent colors/material accents, save it in the project, show a numbered still contact sheet, and stop for a second approval. It must not call any video provider yet.

evals.prompt: 这些彩色拼贴静帧全部通过，帮我继续生成视频。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 3, should automatically use Yijia through scripts/generate_yijia_video.py and /v1/videos without asking for a model. It should upload local still images to Volcengine TOS when configured, submit one image with one prompt per job, preserve raw provider videos unless the user asks for trimming or audio removal, create contact sheets, run ffprobe QA, and record provider quirks such as returned model or true duration. It must not default to Veo.

evals.prompt: 这五条里 1、2、4 的隐喻通过，3 和 5 我还想改。先继续下一步。
evals.expected_output: Should advance only items 1, 2 and 4 to still generation while keeping items 3 and 5 at the metaphor revision gate. It must not generate video for any item.
